precedence: firebase-tools-15.22.0 commands/{emulators-export,use,target-apply,target-clear,firestore-delete,init}.js, lib/rc.js, emulator/controller.js exportEmulatorData, bin/cli.js --debug, init/features/* templates, emulator/functionsEmulatorShell.js envelopes, lib/mcp emulator-facing tools
fireside's model where the official command depends on a login, a cloud project or a second Functions runtime

recorded.export: the CLI reads <tmpdir>/hub-<project>.json, GETs the hub root, refuses a non-empty destination that is not an export unless --force, POSTs /_admin/export {path, initiatedBy, targets}; the hub process writes, moves and cleans
recorded.use: every form is behind requireAuth and setNewActive calls the projects API
recorded.targets: target:apply/clear only need the config; lib/rc.js applyTarget removes the resource from any other target of the type first
recorded.firestoreDelete: requirePermissions forces a login even against the emulator; deletes run as runQuery + commit batches of 250 over ordinary REST
recorded.init: per-feature auth is skipped for demo-* ids; firestore/storage features write the locked templates without a project; functions scaffolding runs npm install
recorded.functionsShell: starts a second Functions emulator on port 5000 and injects background events in-process into a worker; there is no functions:invoke command in firebase-tools
recorded.debug: firebase-debug.log in the cwd on every invocation, unlinked on a clean exit unless DEBUG is set; downloadable emulators write <name>-debug.log truncated per start
recorded.exec: emulators:exec takes one shell string run through the shell

wrapper.unit: packaging/cli.test.mjs (+ packaging/cli-commands.test.mjs when present): every new command against fake binaries, a fake hub/Firestore/Auth server and temporary projects
wrapper.publishedFileList: packaging/public-artifacts.mjs and packaging/local-platforms.test.mjs enumerate every published CLI file

functionsShell.policy: not provided; Fireside never starts a second Functions runtime; functions:invoke --event-data delivers a background event to the running suite instead

mcp.policy: a dependency-free stdio JSON-RPC server with the emulator-facing tools only; no cloud-management tools, no telemetry

debugLog.policy: always written under the run directory when --debug is given, never deleted by the CLI; one file with an emulator label per record instead of per-emulator files

execShellString.policy: a single positional script without -- runs through the platform shell like the official CLI, with a note; the -- argv form stays free of shell interpretation

firestoreDeleteForce.policy: recursive collection deletes and --all-collections require --force (the official CLI prompts; Fireside is non-interactive)
